headlines.text: On this day in 2022, the AEW World Heavyweight Title was up for grabs as Jon Moxley vs. Penta El Zero M went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.51. Penta El Zero M was challenging for gold for the very first time. A hard-fought battle for the gold.
Turning the clock back to 2024: Viva Van was back in action after just under 3 months away, appearing on Collision.
It was 2022 when Castagnoli & Yuta stepped through the curtain for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.91.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2022, when Cash Wheeler reached a real marker of consistency: their 50th match in AEW, facing Swerve in our Glory vs. FTR on Dynamite, rated 7.67 ? a good, competitive contest in a back-and-forth tag team affair.
Flash back to 2024, when Robyn Renegade stepped back through the curtain after 2 months away, appearing on Collision.
Looking back to 2022, when Riho made their return to AEW television after just under 6 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
